title: Dcore
description: A lightweight with custom Achievement/Death/Kill messages. And homes, teleportation, auth, kits, and admin tools in a clean GUI.
body:
# ⚡ DCore: The Ultimate Lightweight Essentials Suite

DCore is a high-performance, all-in-one "Essentials" style plugin designed to provide every core feature a modern Minecraft server needs without the bloat. From a robust teleportation system to a secure built-in authentication layer, DCore handles it all through an intuitive in-game GUI.

## 🚀 Key Features

### 🏠 Home & Teleportation
* **Home System:** Save multiple homes and manage them through a clean Inventory GUI.
* **TPA System:** Seamless player-to-player teleport requests (`/tpa`, `/tpahere`).
* **Admin TP:** Powerful teleport tools for staff, including `/tphere` and coordinate-based travel.

### 🔐 Secure Auth System
* **Built-in Login/Register:** Protect player accounts on your server without needing extra plugins.
* **Admin Controls:** Admins can reset player passwords instantly via `/resetpassword` (with shorthand aliases like `/rep` and `/rsp`).
* **Security Restrictions:** Unauthenticated players are restricted from moving, chatting, or interacting until they log in.

### 📦 Kits & Utilities
* **Timed Kits:** Create kits with custom cooldowns for players to claim.
* **Admin Kit GUI:** A powerful visual editor to create and modify kits in real-time.
* **Virtual Disposal:** Quickly clear inventory clutter with `/disposal`.
* **Item & Recipe Tools:** Check item IDs with `/itemdb` or view crafting recipes with `/recipe`.

### 🛠️ Professional Admin Suite
* **Moderation:** Full support for `/ban`, `/tempban`, `/kick`, and `/sudo`.
* **Flight:** Toggle `/fly` for yourself or other players.
* **Settings GUI:** Use `/dcore` to open a master control panel where you can enable or disable any command in the plugin on the fly.

### ✨ Polish & Immersion
* **Stylized Messages:** Custom Join/Quit alerts and enhanced death messages (with icons!).
* **Advancement Alerts:** Clean, formatted announcements when players reach milestones.
* **Optimized Performance:** Built for high-player-count environments with minimal CPU/RAM impact.

---

## 🛠️ Compatibility & Technical Specs
* **Supported Loaders:** Paper, Spigot, Purpur, Pufferfish.
* **Minecraft Versions:** 1.17.x – 1.21.11 (Full cross-version support).
* **Java Requirement:** Java 17 or newer.

---

## 📜 Commands & Aliases

* `/sethome` - Set a home at your location
* `/home` - Teleport to a home
* `/tpa` - Request teleport to player
* `/register` (Aliases: `/r`) - Create an account
* `/login` (Aliases: `/l`) - Log in to account
* `/resetpassword` (Aliases: `/rep`, `/rsp`, `/resetp`) - Reset a player's password (Admin)
* `/dcore` - Master Settings GUI

> ⚠️ **Note:** DCore is currently in Beta. While it is stable enough for testing, it is still under development and may cause unexpected issues or bugs. Please ensure you take regular backups of your configuration files and report any issues you encounter.
